evidence_snippets: Column-level lineage limitations Column-level lineage has the following additional limitations: Column-level lineage isn't collected for BigQuery load jobs or for routines.
Column-level lineage isn't collected if a job creates more than 1,500 column-level links.
Column-level lineage is only fetched from the region where the root table is located.
